dialogues.jp:
家に帰ってもすることないからと、暇つぶしに
神社へやってきた。
dialogues.en:
With nothing to do, and not wanting to go home just yet, I
ended up at the shrine.
dialogues.text:
With nothing to do, and not wanting to go home just yet, I
ended up at the shrine.

dialogues.jp: 本来、暇を潰すような場所ではないんだけど。
dialogues.en:
Originally, this was hardly a place I'd spend just killing
time.
dialogues.text:
Originally, this was hardly a place I'd spend just killing
time.

dialogues.jp: 環と話をするだけでも、楽しいだろう。
dialogues.en:
But now that Tamaki is there... it's fun just talking with
her.
dialogues.text:
But now that Tamaki is there... it's fun just talking with
her.

dialogues.jp:
赤い鳥居の前で、いつものように環は境内を掃
除している。
dialogues.en: She was there, sweeping as usual, under the archway.
dialogues.text: She was there, sweeping as usual, under the archway.

dialogues.jp: 「よ、環」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: 俺は掃除をしている環に声をかける。
dialogues.en: I called out to Tamaki, who was sweeping the floor calmly.
dialogues.text: I called out to Tamaki, who was sweeping the floor calmly.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: 環は｛ほうき／箒｝の手を休め、俺に微笑む。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki leaned her hands on her broom, and smiled gently to
me.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki leaned her hands on her broom, and smiled gently to
me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日はどうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What would be the matter today?"
dialogues.text: "What would be the matter today?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うん、ちょっと暇つぶしにな」
dialogues.en: "Nothing much, just a little bored."
dialogues.text: "Nothing much, just a little bored."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか。嬉しいです」
dialogues.en: "I see... I'm happy."
dialogues.text: "I see... I'm happy."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　何でだよ」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Why?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Why?"

dialogues.jp: 環の言葉にドギマギする。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's sudden change of topic was odd.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's sudden change of topic was odd.

dialogues.jp:
俺が来たから嬉しい言われると、なんだかやけ
に嬉しいものだ。
dialogues.en:
Why would my coming out of boredom be something happy for
her?
dialogues.text:
Why would my coming out of boredom be something happy for
her?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「だって、普通暇つぶしに神社に来てくれる人っ
　て、少ないじゃないですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, there are few people who would come to a shrine when
they have no purpose in mind."
dialogues.text:
"Well, there are few people who would come to a shrine when
they have no purpose in mind."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様が、それだけ神社に興味を持ってくれ
　てるっていうのは、嬉しいことですよ」
dialogues.en: "Since you have such interest in it though, I'm happy."
dialogues.text: "Since you have such interest in it though, I'm happy."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、日本人の根幹の部分だからな……」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's any Japanese's tradition to visit shrines..."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's any Japanese's tradition to visit shrines..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……それに、朝倉様とお話できるのは、やは
　り楽しいですもの」
dialogues.en:
"....And, being able to talk to Asakura-sama... is always
fun for me."
dialogues.text:
"....And, being able to talk to Asakura-sama... is always
fun for me."

dialogues.jp: 「……。今日も、いい天気だな」
dialogues.en: "...The weather's good today."
dialogues.text: "...The weather's good today."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、適当に誤魔化す。
dialogues.en: Decoy plan #1, activate.
dialogues.text: Decoy plan #1, activate.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんですか？　急に」
dialogues.en:
"My, is there something wrong? Bringing that up so
suddenly..."
dialogues.text:
"My, is there something wrong? Bringing that up so
suddenly..."

dialogues.jp: 環は口に手を当てて笑いながら答える。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki brought her hand to her mouth, covering her slight
laughter.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki brought her hand to her mouth, covering her slight
laughter.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「なんだか、今日の朝倉様は様子がおかしいで
　すね」
dialogues.en: "You seem to be a touch odd today, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "You seem to be a touch odd today, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、いつもこんなものだ」
dialogues.en: "...Nah, I'm always like this."
dialogues.text: "...Nah, I'm always like this."

dialogues.jp:
しかし、あらためて暇つぶしに来たっていうと
実際に何をしていいかわからない。
dialogues.en:
And I came here out of boredom in the first place... now
that I'm here, I didn't really know what to do.
dialogues.text:
And I came here out of boredom in the first place... now
that I'm here, I didn't really know what to do.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、何かしなきゃいけないのではと思っ
てしまう。
dialogues.en: I wonder what IS there to do in a place like this, anyway...
dialogues.text: I wonder what IS there to do in a place like this, anyway...

dialogues.jp: 「あのさ、環」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tamaki?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp: この場でなにかできることはないか？
dialogues.en: Is there anything to do here?
dialogues.text: Is there anything to do here?

dialogues.jp:
参拝をしたって、５分もかからないうちに終わっ
てしまう。
dialogues.en: A prayer would take maybe 5 minutes, maximum.
dialogues.text: A prayer would take maybe 5 minutes, maximum.

dialogues.jp:
できれば、環と話でもしながらできるようなこ
とってないかな。
dialogues.en:
If I had to choose, I'd rather just stay here and talk more
with Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
If I had to choose, I'd rather just stay here and talk more
with Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
「──そうだ、ホウキ貸してもらえないか。せっ
　かくだから、掃除を手伝ってやるよ」
dialogues.en:
"--Ah yeah, why don't you lend me your broom? Since I'm
here, I might as well help clean up the place."
dialogues.text:
"--Ah yeah, why don't you lend me your broom? Since I'm
here, I might as well help clean up the place."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　本当ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah... really?"
dialogues.text: "Ah... really?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、この広い敷地を全部掃除するのは大変
　だろ？　掃除なら、話をしながらでも出来る
　しな」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, it'd be tough to clean this whole big place alone.
And we can talk while sweeping, anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, it'd be tough to clean this whole big place alone.
And we can talk while sweeping, anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、これ使ってください。新しいの持って
　きますから」
dialogues.en: "Okay then! Please use this, I will retrieve a new broom."
dialogues.text: "Okay then! Please use this, I will retrieve a new broom."

dialogues.jp: 環はそう言って、奥へと入っていった。
dialogues.en: She disappeared inside the shrine shortly after.
dialogues.text: She disappeared inside the shrine shortly after.

dialogues.jp: はあ。
dialogues.en: Sigh.
dialogues.text: Sigh.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環が掃いた葉を集めたり、散らしたりし
ながら、環を待つ。
dialogues.en:
I awaited her reappearance, as the wind scattered her
gathered leaves.
dialogues.text:
I awaited her reappearance, as the wind scattered her
gathered leaves.

dialogues.jp: 環は、｛たけぼうき／竹箒｝を持って戻ってくる。
dialogues.en: She eventually returned with another bamboo-stick broom.
dialogues.text: She eventually returned with another bamboo-stick broom.

dialogues.jp: 「よし、さっそく始めるか」
dialogues.en: "Alright, let's get started."
dialogues.text: "Alright, let's get started."

dialogues.jp: 俺と環はあたりの落ち葉を箒で集める。
dialogues.en:
We started sweeping all the nearby leaves into a single
pile.
dialogues.text:
We started sweeping all the nearby leaves into a single
pile.

dialogues.jp:
落ち葉の中には、タバコの吸殻や誰かが落とし
たおみくじが混じっている。
dialogues.en: Mixed among the pile of leaves, was a cigarette butt.
dialogues.text: Mixed among the pile of leaves, was a cigarette butt.

dialogues.jp: 「ったく、神社にゴミを捨てるとは罰当たりな」
dialogues.en: "Geez, these people who treat a shrine as a rubbish bin..."
dialogues.text: "Geez, these people who treat a shrine as a rubbish bin..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「参拝者が朝倉様のような人ばかりですと、助
　かるんですが……」
dialogues.en:
"There are many worshippers who aren't as upstanding as you,
I'm glad you're here to help..."
dialogues.text:
"There are many worshippers who aren't as upstanding as you,
I'm glad you're here to help..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そういえば昔、神社の石は持って帰っちゃい
　けないって、聞いたことあるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh yeah, it used to be that the shrine wouldn't allow
people to take rocks back with them, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh yeah, it used to be that the shrine wouldn't allow
people to take rocks back with them, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんですけどね。でも、子供たちはよく
　持って帰りますよ。遊びに使うみたいで」
dialogues.en:
"That used to be true, but now, children do it all the
time."
dialogues.text:
"That used to be true, but now, children do it all the
time."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「道路に絵を描いたりとか、石投げにつかった
　りとかな」
dialogues.en:
"We'd draw on an empty sidewalk, and used to play
hopskotch..."
dialogues.text:
"We'd draw on an empty sidewalk, and used to play
hopskotch..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺も持って帰った記憶ある」
dialogues.en: "I remember doing that before."
dialogues.text: "I remember doing that before."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……他の記憶は、無いんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...You don't remember anything else?"
dialogues.text: "...You don't remember anything else?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: 他の記憶……？
dialogues.en: Remember anything else...?
dialogues.text: Remember anything else...?

dialogues.jp:
「他の記憶って……、そりゃ、小さいことなら
　いくらでもあるけど」
dialogues.en: "If you mean memories of my childhood, sure I do, but..."
dialogues.text: "If you mean memories of my childhood, sure I do, but..."

dialogues.jp: うーん、と頭を捻る。
dialogues.en: I tilted my head in thought.
dialogues.text: I tilted my head in thought.

dialogues.jp:
環が聞くからには、神社の記憶ってことなんだ
ろうけど、それほど話して面白い記憶はない。
dialogues.en:
Now that Tamaki said it, i don't really have anything
memorable of this shrine.
dialogues.text:
Now that Tamaki said it, i don't really have anything
memorable of this shrine.

dialogues.jp: 「取り立てて、話すほどの記憶はないな」
dialogues.en: "...Not anything special about here."
dialogues.text: "...Not anything special about here."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……そうですか」
dialogues.en: "...I see."
dialogues.text: "...I see."

dialogues.jp: 環が、ふぅとため息をつく。
dialogues.en: Tamaki seemed to sigh a little.
dialogues.text: Tamaki seemed to sigh a little.

dialogues.jp:
「もしかして、俺と環の『深い絆』ってヤツに
　関係があるのかな？」
dialogues.en:
"Are you referring to that "deep bond" that we're supposed
to have?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you referring to that "deep bond" that we're supposed
to have?"

dialogues.jp:
環は俯いたまま、何かを考え込んでいるように
見えた。
dialogues.en:
She was staring at the floor again, thinking hard about
something.
dialogues.text:
She was staring at the floor again, thinking hard about
something.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki...?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki...?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「かもしれません」
dialogues.en: "Maybe..."
dialogues.text: "Maybe..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、ぼそりとそう呟いた。
dialogues.en: She muttered, barely audible.
dialogues.text: She muttered, barely audible.

dialogues.jp:
「ううん……。やっぱり、それらしい記憶はな
　いんだよなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Well... I really don't have any memories of that either."
dialogues.text: "Well... I really don't have any memories of that either."

dialogues.jp:
覚えがないにしても、何かがあるなら、やはり
子どもの時のことに違いない。
dialogues.en:
I don't remember anything, but doubtlessly, if there was
something, it would be during my childhood days.
dialogues.text:
I don't remember anything, but doubtlessly, if there was
something, it would be during my childhood days.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、俺も環も思い出せないというのは……。
いったいどういうことなんだろうか。
dialogues.en:
But to have both of us unable to remember it... makes me
curious.
dialogues.text:
But to have both of us unable to remember it... makes me
curious.

dialogues.jp: 二人をつないでいる、『絆』って、何なんだ？
dialogues.en: Just what is that bond that connects the two of us?
dialogues.text: Just what is that bond that connects the two of us?

dialogues.jp: 俺が思い出そうと考えていると、
dialogues.en: In the middle of my train of thought,
dialogues.text: In the middle of my train of thought,

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「だいぶ綺麗になりましたね。少し休みましょ
　うか？」
dialogues.en:
"This is a marvelous sight... shall we rest for a little
while?"
dialogues.text:
"This is a marvelous sight... shall we rest for a little
while?"

dialogues.jp: と、一方的に会話を変えてしまった。
dialogues.en: Which ended the one-sided "conversation".
dialogues.text: Which ended the one-sided "conversation".

dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、そうだな」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, let's."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, let's."

dialogues.jp:
それ以上は何も聞けず、俺と環は、集めた落ち
葉に火をつける。
dialogues.en:
Stopping our sweeping, we set our gathered leaves ablaze in
a fire.
dialogues.text:
Stopping our sweeping, we set our gathered leaves ablaze in
a fire.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「フフフ。時期はずれですけど」
dialogues.en: "Hehe, it's a little out of the season for this, but..."
dialogues.text: "Hehe, it's a little out of the season for this, but..."

dialogues.jp:
環は、どこから持ってきたのか、串に刺さった
餅を俺に渡す。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was roasting a mochi over the fire, wherever she
produced it from.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was roasting a mochi over the fire, wherever she
produced it from.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当はお芋がいいんですけどね」
dialogues.en: "I guess potatoes would be better."
dialogues.text: "I guess potatoes would be better."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、これはこれで良さそうだ」
dialogues.en:
"Nah, it'd be good because of what it is, not what it's
not."
dialogues.text:
"Nah, it'd be good because of what it is, not what it's
not."

dialogues.jp:
餅は時々バチっとはぜながら、どんどん姿を膨
らませていった。
dialogues.en: The mochi swelled slowly from the roasting.
dialogues.text: The mochi swelled slowly from the roasting.

dialogues.jp:
俺達は焚き火で膨らんだ餅をふーふーしながら、
かぶりつく。
dialogues.en:
We sat around the campfire, blowing air at our heated mochis
to cool them down.
dialogues.text:
We sat around the campfire, blowing air at our heated mochis
to cool them down.

dialogues.jp: それにしても、深い絆ってなんだろうな。
dialogues.en: Just what is that deep bond...
dialogues.text: Just what is that deep bond...

dialogues.jp: ◆神社の掃除◆
dialogues.en: ◆Shrine Sweeping?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Shrine Sweeping?◆

dialogues.jp: 暇つぶしに神社に寄った俺は環の掃除を手伝う。
dialogues.en:
With time on my hands, I ended up at the shrine, helping
Tamaki to sweep up the surroundings.
dialogues.text:
With time on my hands, I ended up at the shrine, helping
Tamaki to sweep up the surroundings.

dialogues.jp:
環は、深い絆を知るために、俺に昔の記憶はな
いかと聞いてくる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki, trying to find out the deep bond between us, tried
to dig out my childhood memories...
dialogues.text:
Tamaki, trying to find out the deep bond between us, tried
to dig out my childhood memories...

dialogues.jp:
が、残念なことに、いまいちそれらしい記憶を
思い出すことは出来なかった。
dialogues.en: But unfortunately, I just couldn't remember anything.
dialogues.text: But unfortunately, I just couldn't remember anything.

dialogues.jp: 俺と環は、集めた落ち葉で、餅を焼いて食べた。
dialogues.en:
In the end, we just sat around a bonfire, eating roasted
mochis.
dialogues.text:
In the end, we just sat around a bonfire, eating roasted
mochis.
